sources.title: GitHub - TheROMZ52/VerityAI: verity is in-game ai helper plugin
sources.snippet: VerityAI allows players to chat directly with an AI assistant inside Minecraft with support for multiple AI models, conversation memory, commands, and server integrations Just to clarify: this plugin is called Verity, but it has absolutely no connection to the Verity mod. They're completely separate projects — the name is the only similarity.
